description: The first real CLI for the Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud platform — every tenant, agent, and usage metric mirrored locally, with cross-tenant rollups no single API call returns.

tools.name: agent-manager_delete-agent
tools.description: Cancel registration of a specific Acronis agent. Required: agent_id. Destructive.

tools.name: agent-manager_delete-agents
tools.description: Cancel registration and delete service accounts for multiple agents. Required: ids. Destructive.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of agent IDs to delete

tools.name: agent-manager_force-agent-update
tools.description: Launch a forced agent update bypassing maintenance windows for specified agents. Required: agent_ids. Returns the new AgentManagerForceAgentUpdateResponse.

params.name: agent_ids
params.description: List of agent IDs to force update

tools.name: agent-manager_get-agent
tools.description: Retrieve details about a specific registered Acronis agent. Required: agent_id. Returns the AgtAgent.

tools.name: agent-manager_get-agent-update-settings
tools.description: Fetch update configuration settings for agents or tenants. Optional: tenant_id. Returns the AgtAgentUpdateSettings.

tools.name: agent-manager_get-hardware-node
tools.description: Retrieve specific hardware node information including storage configuration. Required: node_id. Returns the AgtHardwareNode.

tools.name: agent-manager_list-agents
tools.description: List all registered Acronis protection agents visible from a specified tenant. Required: tenant_id. Optional: os_family, os_arch, limit (default: 100) (plus 1 more). Returns array of AgtAgent.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Tenant UUID to scope agent listing

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of agents to return

tools.name: agent-manager_list-hardware-nodes
tools.description: List all hardware nodes visible from a specified tenant. Required: tenant_id. Returns array of AgtHardwareNode.

tools.name: agent-manager_update-agent-update-settings
tools.description: Store or update agent update configuration settings including maintenance windows. Optional: automatic, maintenance_window, update_channel. Returns the updated AgtAgentUpdateSettings.

params.name: automatic
params.description: Whether updates should be applied automatically

tools.name: clients_create
tools.description: Create a new OAuth2 client credential for API authentication. Required: tenant_id, type. Optional: data. Returns the new Client.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Tenant UUID to associate the client with

tools.name: clients_delete
tools.description: Delete an OAuth2 client credential. Required: client_id. Destructive.

tools.name: clients_get
tools.description: Retrieve details about a specific OAuth2 client. Required: client_id. Returns the Client.

tools.name: clients_list
tools.description: List OAuth2 client credentials registered in the system. Optional: tenant_id. Returns array of Client.

tools.name: idp_request-token
tools.description: Request an OAuth2 access token using client credentials, authorization code, or other grant types. Required: grant_type. Optional: client_id, client_secret. Returns the new TokenResponse.

tools.name: idp_revoke-token
tools.description: Revoke an OAuth2 access or refresh token. Required: token.

tools.name: remote_search_remote_search
tools.description: Search for tenants and users by name, email, or login across the accessible hierarchy. Required: query. Optional: tenant_id, limit (default: 10). Returns the SearchResults.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Scope search to a specific tenant subtree

tools.name: reports_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled or on-demand usage report configuration. Optional: parameters, schedule. Returns the new Report.

tools.name: task-manager_get-activity
tools.description: Retrieve details about a specific task activity by ID. Required: activity_id. Returns the TaskActivity.

tools.name: task-manager_get-task
tools.description: Retrieve details about a specific backup or protection task by ID. Required: task_id. Returns the TaskTask.

tools.name: task-manager_list-activities
tools.description: Fetch a list of task activities with filtering and pagination. Optional: tenant_id, task_id, state (plus 2 more). Returns array of TaskActivity.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Filter activities by parent task ID

tools.name: task-manager_list-tasks
tools.description: Fetch a list of backup and protection tasks with filtering, ordering, and pagination support. Optional: tenant_id, state, result_code (plus 5 more). Returns array of TaskTask.

tools.name: tenants_create
tools.description: Create a new tenant as a child of an existing tenant. Required: kind, name, parent_id. Optional: contact, enabled. Returns the new Tenant.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Whether the tenant should be enabled

tools.name: tenants_delete
tools.description: Delete a tenant. The tenant must have no children or active services. Required: tenant_id, version. Destructive.

tools.name: tenants_get
tools.description: Retrieve details about a specific tenant by ID. Required: tenant_id. Returns the Tenant.

tools.name: tenants_list
tools.description: List tenants in the hierarchy. Can filter by parent tenant UUID or retrieve by specific UUIDs. Optional: parent_id, uuids, subtree_root_id. Returns array of Tenant.

params.name: parent_id
params.description: Filter tenants by parent tenant UUID

params.name: uuids
params.description: Comma-separated list of tenant UUIDs to retrieve

params.name: subtree_root_id
params.description: Root tenant UUID for subtree traversal

tools.name: tenants_update
tools.description: Update tenant properties including name, contact, and enabled status. Required: tenant_id, kind, name, parent_id. Optional: contact, enabled. Returns the updated Tenant.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Whether the tenant should be enabled

tools.name: tenants_offering-items_list
tools.description: List all offering items (services and quotas) configured for a tenant. Required: tenant_id. Optional: edition. Returns array of OfferingItem.

tools.name: tenants_offering-items_update
tools.description: Enable, disable, or set quotas for offering items on a tenant. Required: tenant_id. Optional: offering_items. Returns array of OfferingItem.

tools.name: tenants_usages_get-tenant
tools.description: Get current usage metrics for a tenant across all services and resources. Required: tenant_id. Optional: edition. Returns array of UsageItem.

tools.name: tenants_users_list-tenant
tools.description: List all users belonging to a specific tenant. Required: tenant_id. Optional: limit (default: 100), after. Returns array of User.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant backup-health rollup
novel_features.description: See backup success / failure / stale across your entire book of customer tenants in one table.

novel_features.name: Offline / stale-agent finder
novel_features.description: List backup agents that haven't checked in within a threshold, across every tenant, sorted by customer.

novel_features.name: Usage-to-billing reconciliation
novel_features.description: Flag usage with no matching offering item and offering items with zero usage, per tenant.

novel_features.name: Coverage gap finder
novel_features.description: Surface tenants that pay for protection but have no online agent or no recent successful backup.

novel_features.name: Usage drift across periods
novel_features.description: Compare per-tenant, per-metric usage between two stored snapshots to see what grew or shrank.

novel_features.name: Agent-version compliance
novel_features.description: Show the distribution of agent versions across the estate and flag tenants behind the target version.

novel_features.name: Tenant-tree explorer
novel_features.description: Render the Partner -> Customer -> Folder -> Unit hierarchy with per-node agent and user counts.

novel_features.name: Backup-failure recurrence ranker
novel_features.description: Rank resources and tenants by how many distinct days in a window had a failed or missed backup.

novel_features.name: Last-night failure board
novel_features.description: Flat list of every failed or missed backup task across all tenants in a recent window, newest first.

novel_features.name: Backup freshness / SLA report
novel_features.description: Time since the last successful backup per tenant, flagged against an SLA threshold — including tenants never backed up.

novel_features.name: Customer 360 card
novel_features.description: One cross-resource snapshot of a single customer: tenant record, users, licenses, usage, agents, and 7-day backup outcomes joined.

novel_features.name: Standard-provisioning auditor
novel_features.description: Flag enabled customer tenants missing users, offering items, agents, or OAuth clients — onboarding drift in one table.

novel_features.name: Offering-item / edition inventory
novel_features.description: Estate-wide rollup of which offering items and editions are enabled, with per-SKU tenant counts.
